summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) disclosing the completion of the automatic conversion of Series O Convertible Preferred Stock into common stock, following a prior special dividend. The conversion occurred on June 25, 2026, at a ratio of 3.209 common shares per preferred share, resulting in 4,857,211 common shares outstanding. The filing provides no board recommendation or advisor details. Structurally, this is a routine corporate action and not an acquisition, tender, or restructuring. It does not represent a special situation event.
